title: Welcome to Natural Hypertrophy: my purpose
summary: Second channel intro: a natural bodybuilding channel focused solely on getting bigger. After nearly 10 years of lifting he wants to teach and prove natural lifters can get big; he shares his stats (25, 6 ft, 210 lb, 17.5-inch arms, 26-inch legs) and the 'Road to' playlists.

claims.claim: The channel is purely about getting bigger naturally; he lifts heavy only in service of hypertrophy.
After almost 10 years of lifting he wants to give back by teaching people to get bigger naturally.
His goal is to prove you can become big as a natural lifter, taking viewers along on his journey to get massive.
The 'Road to' playlists summarize all his training per body part so viewers can replicate the workouts.
